patient_persona.description: Tok Hashim bin Daud, 74, male, retired rubber tapper from Kuala Kangsar, Perak; smoked rokok daun for 50 years, day 3 in the medical ward. Breathless, slow, deep Perak Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Pavithra Raman, Malaysian Indian woman in her 30s, medical officer at Hospital Kuala Kangsar, ward round. Soft-spoken, patient; Malay with English ward terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Assalamualaikum, tok. Hari ni breathing macam mana? Masih sesak?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kurang sikit dah, doktor. Semalam nak pergi toilet pun tak larat. Hari ni boleh jalan sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Oxygen tok sekarang 92 percent dengan dua liter. Untuk tok, target 88 hingga 92, so ini okay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kenapa tak boleh tinggi macam orang lain, doktor? Seratus percent?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paru-paru tok dah ada COPD. Kalau oxygen terlalu tinggi, badan tok simpan carbon dioxide, nanti mengantuk dan keliru.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, macam tu. Ubat drip tu bila nak habis?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: IV antibiotic kita tukar ke ubat makan hari ni. Prednisolone 30mg, hari ketiga dah, total lima hari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Nebuliser salbutamol dengan ipratropium kita kurangkan ke empat kali sehari, then esok try tukar ke inhaler.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Inhaler tu susah nak guna, doktor. Tangan saya menggeletar.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, kita bagi spacer, lebih senang. Physio dan pharmacist akan ajar tok sebelum balik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Rokok daun tu, kena berhenti betul-betul ke? Saya dah hisap sejak umur dua puluh.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, tok. Itu satu-satunya cara nak slowkan kerosakan paru-paru. Kami ada ubat, nicotine patch, boleh bantu berhenti.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susah, tapi saya cuba lah. Cucu saya pun marah, dia kata smoking bahaya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Kalau semua okay, lusa boleh discharge, and kita refer ke pulmonary rehab di klinik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor. Jaga tok baik-baik.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Tan Ah Seng, 68, male, retired taxi driver in Bukit Baru, Melaka; COPD on tiotropium, still smokes ten a day. Gruff, raspy voice, Melaka Mandarin with Hokkien words and Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Rizal Harun, Malay man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at a Melaka health clinic who speaks conversational Mandarin. Honest, a bit humorous; Mandarin with English and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tan 伯，拿药是吗？三个月过得怎样？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 差不多啦，爬楼梯还是喘，走去 kedai kopi 要停两次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 Spiriva 每天早上有喷吗？这个 Respimat 要 press 两下哦。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有啊，每天早上。以前按一下而已，nurse 教我才知道要两下。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 好。那烟呢？上次你说要减少。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 减少了啦，一天十支而已。以前一包的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 减少是好开始，但是 COPD 的人 smoking 就算一天五支，肺还是一直坏下去。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我也知道，但是一坐下来喝 kopi，就想 sebatang。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我明白。我们可以试 nicotine patch，21mg，每天贴一片，再加 gum，想抽的时候咬。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Patch 贴在哪里？洗澡可以吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 贴在 lengan 或者胸口，每天换位置。洗澡没问题。晚上 dream 很多的话，可以睡前撕掉。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，试看。医生，最近早上的痰比较多，黄黄的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有发烧吗？喘有比平时严重吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有烧，喘就差不多。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那我开一个 rescue pack 给你：prednisolone 30mg 五天，还有 doxycycline 100mg。如果痰变绿、喘更严重，就开始吃，然后打电话给 klinik。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我会记得。谢谢医生，下次我烟一定少过五支。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 最好是零支，Tan 伯。我们下个月见，看 patch 有没有 work。

patient_persona.description: Mr. Selvaraj a/l Arumugam, 62, male, retired estate supervisor in Sungai Petani, Kedah; smoker for 40 years, breathless for a year. Soft, measured Malaysian Indian English with Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Fatimah Azzahra Ismail, Malay woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at a Sungai Petani health clinic. Clear, empathetic; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle Selvaraj, the spirometry results are back. Let me explain what the numbers mean.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Please, doctor. My son says must faham properly, don't just makan ubat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your FEV1 is 58 percent of expected, and the ratio is 0.55. Even lepas Ventolin, tak banyak improve. This confirms COPD.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: COPD. Is that like asthma? My jiran has asthma, dia guna pam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Similar symptoms, but different. In COPD, the damage is mostly permanent, usually from smoking. Tapi we can slow it down and help you breathe better.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Forty years I smoked. Estate life, everybody smoke, no one tell us bahaya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The most important treatment now is berhenti merokok. Everything else is second.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I already reduce to five sticks, doctor. Stop totally quite susah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll refer you to our quit clinic. We can use varenicline, satu biji twice a day, it cuts the craving a lot.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For your breathing, I'll start tiotropium, Spiriva, two puffs once a day. Ventolin two puffs bila sesak.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Anything else I should do, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Walk every day, even ten minutes around the taman. Influenza vaccine yearly, and pneumococcal vaccine once.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: How long can I hidup with this, doctor? Frankly.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Many people live for years with moderate COPD, especially kalau berhenti merokok. Your future is quite dalam tangan you sendiri.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alright, doctor. I'll try my best for my cucu-cucu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Jumpa lagi in one month, and bawa the quit clinic card.

patient_persona.description: Mdm. Chin Siew Lan, 74, female, retired Hakka farmer in Sandakan, Sabah; never smoked but cooked over a wood fire for decades. Quiet, slow voice, Mandarin with Hakka-flavoured words and Sabah Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chiew Mei Ying, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical officer at the Duchess of Kent Hospital respiratory clinic, Sandakan. Gentle and encouraging; Mandarin with English and Malay terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 陈阿婆，你去 pulmonary rehab 两个月了，感觉怎样？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有好一点。以前走到 dapur 就喘，现在可以在花园走一圈，no need rest。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很好！我们上次的 six-minute walk 是 220 米，今天是 290 米，进步很多。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 真的吗？我自己也觉得脚比较有力了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 inhaler 是 Trelegy，每天一次，一下，有记得吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有，我女儿每天早上提醒我。喷完就漱口。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 做得很好。你没有 smoking，但是以前烧柴煮饭很多年，那个 smoke 也会伤肺。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 以前在乡下没有煤气嘛，每天都烧柴，烟很大。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 现在家里还有烧东西吗？比如拜神烧香？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 初一十五会烧香，在前面 anjung 那边。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 烧香的时候你站远一点，或者让孙子去烧。Buka tingkap，不要吸那个烟。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好的。那个 oxygen 机，我需要吗？邻居有一台。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你今天休息的时候 oxygen 94，走路最低 90，暂时不需要 home oxygen。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那就好，那个机器很吵。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 继续做运动，每天走两次，每次十五分钟。三个月后回来，我们再做一次 lung function test。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，谢谢医生，terima kasih banyak。

patient_persona.description: Pak Mat Zin bin Awang, 63, male, fisherman in Chendering, Kuala Terengganu; smoker, COPD diagnosed last year. Loud, rough voice, heavy Terengganu Malay, few English words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kevin Lim Wei Ming, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, emergency physician at Hospital Sultanah Nur Zahirah. Calm, simple language; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak Mat, dah rasa lega sikit lepas nebuliser?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lega dah, doktor. Tadi rasa macam lemas atas bot.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sesak dah berapa hari? Kahak warna apa? Ada fever?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiga hari. Kahak kuning pekat, banyak. Tak demam, doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Oxygen sekarang 93 percent. Chest X-ray takda pneumonia. Ini COPD flare-up, paru-paru radang sebab jangkitan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena admit ke, doktor? Esok nak turun laut, ikan tengah banyak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak Mat boleh balik, tapi tak boleh turun laut minggu ni. Saya bagi MC seminggu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Prednisolone 30mg, sekali sehari pagi lepas makan, five days. Doxycycline 100mg, twice a day, lima hari, with plenty of water.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat inhaler yang klinik bagi dulu tu, saya tak guna sangat. Lupa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yang mana satu? Warna apa?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yang kelabu tu, Spiriva kot. Saya simpan dalam laci, doktor, jarang guna.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itu ubat harian, kena guna setiap pagi, dua puff. Kalau tak guna, senang kena serangan macam hari ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, saya ingat bila sesak je guna. Silap lah saya, no wonder attack datang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, sekarang dah tahu. Ventolin untuk bila sesak, Spiriva setiap pagi walaupun rasa sihat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Faham, doktor. Rokok pun kena stop ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, Pak Mat. Rokok tu yang paling bahaya. Pergi klinik kesihatan minggu depan, dia orang ada quit smoking service.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Saya cuba. Terima kasih.

patient_persona.description: Mohd Ridzuan bin Lajim, 30, male, Bajau security guard in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah; six weeks of cough, night sweats and weight loss. Quiet, worried, Sabah Malay with some English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Evelyn Chong Siew Yin, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Kota Kinabalu health clinic TB unit. Warm, non-judgemental; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Ridzuan, keputusan sputum dah keluar. Positive for TB, tuberculosis. Chest X-ray pun ada shadow kat paru-paru kanan atas.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: TB? Alamak. Saya ingat batuk biasa je bah. Macam mana saya boleh dapat infection ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: TB merebak melalui udara, bila orang yang ada TB batuk. Kadang-kadang kita tak tahu siapa source dia.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh sembuh ke, doktor? Saya takut, honestly.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh sembuh sepenuhnya, asalkan makan ubat cukup enam bulan, setiap hari, tanpa miss.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dua bulan pertama, empat jenis ubat dalam satu tablet, nama dia Akurit-4. Berat encik 52kg, jadi tiga biji sekali sehari, pagi sebelum makan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiga biji sehari, six months? Lama juga bah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lama, tapi penting. Kita buat DOTS, directly observed therapy, maksudnya encik datang klinik every day, nurse tengok encik telan ubat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya kerja shift malam. Susah nak datang pagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita boleh atur. Mungkin encik datang lepas habis shift, pukul lapan pagi, atau video DOTS guna phone.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Family saya macam mana? Isteri dengan anak dua orang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Semua kena buat saringan, X-ray dan test. Anak-anak bawah lima tahun mungkin perlu ubat pencegahan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kencing jadi warna oren, itu normal, side effect rifampicin. Tapi kalau mata kuning, vomiting, atau rash, bagitahu terus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Faham, doktor. Kerja saya macam mana? Boleh masuk shift?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dua minggu pertama rehat di rumah, pakai mask. Lepas tu biasanya dah tak berjangkit, boleh kerja semula.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor. Saya akan makan ubat betul-betul.

patient_persona.description: Mdm. Leong Mei Chu, 55, female, noodle stall owner in Kepong, Kuala Lumpur; type 2 diabetes; two months into TB treatment. Talkative, Cantonese-accented Mandarin with English and Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Hafizuddin Rahim, Malay man in his 30s, chest physician at a KL hospital TB clinic who speaks some Mandarin. Kind, systematic; Mandarin with English, switches to Malay words when stuck.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 梁女士，两个月的 intensive phase 已经完成了。你的 sputum 今天是 negative，很好。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 真的吗？太好了！咳嗽差不多没有了，weight 也回来了两公斤。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那我们现在换去 maintenance phase，四个月，只剩下两种药，isoniazid 和 rifampicin。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那药比较少了，好。医生，我的 sugar 最近比较高，是不是药的关系？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有可能。Rifampicin 会让一些 diabetes 药效果变差。你现在吃什么？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Gliclazide 80mg 早晚一粒，metformin 也是。早上验血，平常八点几，现在十一。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我请 diabetes nurse 帮你调药，gliclazide 可能要加。TB 期间血糖控制好，药会比较 work。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。另外，我的脚底最近麻麻的，像蚂蚁在爬。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个可能是 isoniazid 的副作用，diabetes 的人更容易。你有吃 pyridoxine 吗？黄色小粒的。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 啊，那个我以为是 vitamin，不重要，所以有时候没吃。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很重要哦，那个就是保护 nerve 的。每天 10mg，跟 TB 药一起吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 原来是这样，那我以后每天都吃。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 liver function test 也正常。还有，档口可以做了吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我两个礼拜前已经回去开档，戴口罩。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sputum 已经 negative，不会传染了，可以放心做。一个月后回来 review，记得带 glucose 记录。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，谢谢医生，terima kasih ya。

patient_persona.description: Mr. Mahendran a/l Govindasamy, 40, male, lorry driver in Prai, Penang; four months into TB treatment; drinks beer on weekends. Easy-going, fast Malaysian Indian English with lots of Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nor Hidayah Ismail, Malay woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Seberang Perai health clinic. Firm but friendly; English mixed with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Mahendran, how's everything? Your DOTS nurse says you've been very consistent, tak pernah miss. Good job.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, doc. Every day I come before my trip. Tapi lately kaki saya rasa kebas, both feet, macam semut gigit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How long already? Ada problem walking or tekan brek?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: About two weeks. Driving okay, but night time it's quite teruk, can't sleep properly.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's likely from the isoniazid. Are you still makan the pyridoxine, the vitamin B6?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: The small one? The pharmacy say out of stock last month, then I terlupa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That explains it. Isoniazid can damage saraf if we don't give B6. I'm increasing pyridoxine to 50mg daily for now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Will it go back to normal? Boleh baik balik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually improves over weeks if we catch it early. Soalan lain, how much are you drinking?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Weekend only lah, doc. Saturday maybe four, five cans with kawan-kawan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Alcohol and isoniazid together can rosakkan hati, and also makes the nerve problem worse. Please stop sampai treatment habis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Two more months only, right? Okay lah, I'll tell my kawan I'm on medicine.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, two more months. Your liver test hari ni, we'll check. Kalau mata kuning or perut sakit, call immediately.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay doc. And driving is safe with the kebas?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For now yes, since your strength is normal. Tapi kalau tak rasa pedal properly, stop driving and see me.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Understood. Thanks, doc.

condition: Tuberculosis contact screening in a child

patient_persona.description: Puan Siti Khadijah binti Omar, 33, female, housewife in Tumpat, Kelantan, bringing her son Irfan, 4, whose grandfather was diagnosed with TB last month. Anxious, Kelantan Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nik Azhar Nik Mahmud, Malay man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at a Tumpat health clinic. Calm, reassuring; Kelantan-flavoured Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Khadijah, Irfan ni cucu Pak Deraman yang kena TB tu kan? The contact case?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya, doktor. Ayah saya duduk serumah dengan kami. Irfan selalu tidur dengan tok ayah dia, rapat sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Irfan ada batuk, demam, atau weight loss sejak sebulan ni?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Takdok, doktor. Dia sihat, makan banyak, main macam biasa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Baik. Kita dah buat Mantoux test hari Isnin. Today we read the result. Bengkak dia 12mm, so positive.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Positif? Maksudnya dia dah kena TB lah, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Maksudnya kuman TB dah masuk badan dia, but not active disease yet. Kita panggil latent TB. X-ray dia pun normal.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Habis tu kena buat apa?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Budak bawah lima tahun senang jadi TB teruk. So kita bagi preventive therapy, isoniazid, enam bulan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Berat Irfan 16kg. Isoniazid 160mg once a day, dengan pyridoxine. Crush the tablet, campur dengan sikit air atau bubur.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Enam bulan tu lama. Ada side effect tak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Budak-budak biasanya tahan ubat ni dengan baik. Kalau dia vomit banyak, mata kuning, atau lemah, bawa datang terus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Adik dia baru enam bulan, still baby. Dia pun kena ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, bawa baby sekali minggu ni untuk screening. Babies also need preventive treatment.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Esok saya bawa adik dia.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Fung Kok Chai, 60, male, Hakka durian orchard owner in Tawau, Sabah; smoker, two months of cough with blood-streaked sputum. Gruff, worried, Mandarin with Hakka-flavoured words and Sabah Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nurul Ain Abdullah, Malay woman in her 30s, medical officer at Hospital Tawau medical clinic, fluent in Mandarin from Chinese school. Calm, careful; Mandarin with English and Malay terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我咳了两个月，最近痰里面有血丝，我老婆很紧张，叫我来 hospital。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 谢谢你来。除了咳嗽，晚上有没有流汗？体重有没有掉？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 晚上流很多汗，床单都湿。Seluar 也松了，可能掉了五六公斤。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你有抽烟对吗？一天多少？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一天一包，抽了四十年。园里的工人也都抽。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 X-ray 右边上面有一个 cavity，就是一个洞。可能是 TB，也可能是别的，比如 lung cancer，所以要验清楚。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 啊？cancer？医生，你不要吓我。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我只是要讲清楚。TB 比较有可能，因为有流汗和掉体重。我们先验三次 sputum，看 TB 细菌，还有 GeneXpert test。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那个要多久才知道？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: GeneXpert 一两天就有结果。等结果的时候，你先住 isolation room，戴 mask。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要住院哦？我的园现在是 musim durian，很忙。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我明白，但是如果是 TB，你会传染给家人和 pekerja。先 confirm，大概两三天而已。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好啦，好啦。我孙子常常来我家玩，他会不会有事？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果证实是 TB，家里每个人都要做 screening，小孩子特别要检查。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那烟呢？我要戒吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 一定要戒。不管是 TB 还是别的，烟都会让肺更差。住院的时候我们可以开始 nicotine patch。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，谢谢医生，我打电话叫老婆拿衣服来。
